name: Checkout Service
description: Orchestrates cart checkout, payment validation, idempotent order reservation, and emits payment authorization events.

name: Token Service
description: Performs zero-knowledge card tokenization, cryptographic key rotation, and PCI token resolution.

name: Billing Engine
description: Consumes payment authorization events, manages recurring subscription cycles, and generates customer invoices.

name: Notification Dispatcher
description: Consumes billing and payment events to send email receipts and webhook alerts to customers.
